description: Live air quality by city or coordinates from Open-Meteo's CAMS models: US AQI and European AQI with PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2 and CO concentrations. No API key, cached 30 minutes — the air-quality check agents should run instead of recalling stale numbers. Use this when an agent needs to uS + European AQI, PM2.5 and ozone by city. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
